title: A Portrait for the Parish
author: Emrys Hartwell
blurb: Rosalind Brightwater, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
